blocks.text: Set up Google Sheets as a native app on Mac

Google Sheets is a browser-based tool. You do not need a heavy install, but you can make it feel native. Open Chrome and go to sheets.google.com. Click the three-dot menu in the top right corner. Select Save and Share, then choose Install page as app. This puts an icon in your dock. You can now launch your SEO trackers with one click.
Essential keyboard shortcuts for SEO speed

SEO work involves moving through thousands of rows. Using the mouse slows you down. Learn these shortcuts to keep your hands on the keyboard. Press ⌘ + / to see the full list of shortcuts. Use ⌘ + ⇧ + H to open the find and replace box for quick keyword cleanup. Use ⌘ + ⌥ + 9 to hide rows you do not need to see right now.
Manage your SEO data with these workflow tips

Consultants often struggle with messy crawl data. Start by cleaning your exports. Use the Data > Split text to columns feature to separate URLs from status codes. If you have duplicate rows from multiple crawls, use Data > Data cleanup > Remove duplicates. This keeps your audit sheets clean and accurate.

Google Sheets can handle up to 20 million cells. Large files with complex formulas will slow down your Mac. If you notice lag, check your formulas. Avoid using too many volatile functions like INDIRECT or OFFSET. These force the sheet to recalculate every time you make a change. Keep your raw data in one sheet and your reports in another.

When you share reports with clients, use view-only access. Click the Share button in the top right. Change the link settings to viewer. This prevents clients from accidentally deleting your formulas. If they need to filter data, suggest they use Filter views instead of editing the main sheet.
How to handle large keyword lists

Keyword research lists often reach tens of thousands of rows. Use the filter feature to drill down into specific search intents. Click Data > Create a filter. You can then sort by search volume or difficulty. If you need to count unique keywords, use the UNIQUE function to see your actual list size.

You spend a lot of time on manual reporting. Use the IMPORTHTML or IMPORTXML functions to pull live data from web pages. This updates your report automatically. Be careful with these functions. If you pull too much data, the sheet may hit the cell limit or run out of memory.

faq.question: Is there a real Google Sheets app for Mac?
faq.answer: No, Google Sheets is a web application. You can create a shortcut that acts like an app using Chrome's install feature.

faq.question: Why is my sheet running slowly?
faq.answer: You might have too many cells or complex formulas. Try to keep your file under 20 million cells and minimize volatile functions.

faq.question: How do I hide columns quickly?
Can I use Google Sheets offline?
faq.answer: Yes, but you must enable offline access in your Google Drive settings while you have an internet connection.
